deities: Veera Narayana Perumal (Vishnu, in a shrine between the Shiva and Ambal temples)

history.summary: Magudeswarar Temple is the famous Paadal Petra Sthalam of Kodumudi on the banks of the Kaveri River, dedicated to Shiva as Magudeswarar and Parvati as Soudambikai/Vadivudainayaki. The shrine is believed to predate the 7th century (Cheras), was expanded under the Cholas (inscriptions from the 10th century onward) and strongly patronized by the Pandyas - hence the name Tiruppandikodumudi, Pandya's Kodumudi - and later the Vijayanagaras. The three Nayanmars (Appar, Sundarar, Sambandar) sang its praise in the Tevaram. Legend says a diamond-like fragment of Mount Meru (a gem Shivalinga) fell here after Vayu's contest with Adisesha, and the site is a major centre of Naga (serpent) worship and Naga Dosha pariharam. Notable features include a three-faced Brahma, a 3000-year-old Vanni tree (sthalavriksha), and a rare tiger-footed Vinayaka. CSV TOWN FLAG: the temple is at Kodumudi, not Erode town (~40 km away); actual town corrected to Kodumudi. The Kaveri is believed to change its course (north-south to eastward) at this spot.

name: Magudeswarar Temple
town_description: Kodumudi is a temple town in Erode district on the banks of the Kaveri River, about 40 km south of Erode town, best known for the Magudeswarar temple; the Kaveri is believed to change its course near the temple.

travel.airport: Tiruchirappalli (Trichy) Airport, about 111 km away (per gotirupati.com).
travel.railway: Kodumudi railway station nearby (Trichy line); Erode Junction about 39 km; Karur Junction about 28 km.
travel.road: Direct buses from Erode and Karur to Kodumudi.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Chithirai (April-May) for the 11-day festival; Aadi Perukku draws heavy crowds (July-August).
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 am to 12:00 pm and 4:00 pm to 9:00 pm daily (timings may change on festival days). Poojas include Usha Kala (6:00 am), Kala Santhi (7:00 am), Uchikala (12:00 pm), Sayarakshai (5:30 pm) and Ardhajama (8:00 pm).
